assamTemporalModel.statutoryAuthority: Representation of the People Act 1950, Section 8A
assamTemporalModel.defectRationale: The 2023 Delimitation Order for Assam is fully modeled from 2023-08-16 onward. Pre-2023 historical lineage across 126 ACs lacks machine-readable statutory vector crosswalks from CEO Assam / ECI, and remains pending official digitization.

rootCauseDetermination.description: AC 119 (Bhadrachalam) is a legitimate multi-part constituency created by the 2014 bifurcation (Polavaram project mandal transfer to AP). Official TGRAC data represents it as a single feature with 2 rings. The open-source Datameet shapefile conversion improperly dumped the 2 parts as 2 separate Polygon Features with identical AC_NO: 119, yielding 120 features for 119 seats.
